symptom: Local cloning a GitHub URL with a global insteadOf rewrite prompted at the proxy authority while the engine credential broker remained scoped to the source authority, so the app clone failed even though a shell clone worked.
rule: bug-fix.md: reproduce clone authentication at cloneRepo, resolve broker authority using Git's applicable URL rewrites, and keep credential capabilities authority-scoped.
check: pnpm test:git apps/desktop/src/engine/git/__tests__/git-exec.test.ts -t "uses the rewritten URL's credential helper when cloning"
